scenes.label: average IRS refund in the 2026 filing season (through May 8)
scenes.say: The average refund this year was about thirty two hundred seventy six dollars.

scenes.label: that money spread across 12 paychecks
scenes.say: Spread over a year, that's about two hundred seventy three dollars a month, often withheld from your own pay.
